title: Out of Time
description: A smooth blend of R&B and pop from The Weeknd's fifth studio album, showcasing his signature falsetto. It explores love, loss, and the passage of time.

title: Hotline Bling
description: A laid-back, dancehall-tinged single built on a warm organ sample, reflecting on a relationship that has moved on.

title: Skyline To
description: A hazy, minimalist track from Blonde that drifts through summer imagery and memory.

title: Just
description: A guitar-driven alt-rock song with a restless, climbing riff and one of the band's most famous music videos.

title: Levitating
description: A disco-pop track with a bouncing bassline and space-themed lyrics.

title: HUMBLE.
description: A sparse, piano-driven beat under a confrontational verse about staying grounded.

title: Kill Bill
description: A breezy, retro-tinged R&B song whose sweet melody contrasts with darkly comic lyrics about an ex.

title: Mr. Brightside
description: A breathless indie-rock anthem about jealousy that has never really left the dance floor.
